name: ishara-film
description: Ishara launch film (docs/demo/video/SCRIPT.md), built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts IsharaFilm out/ishara-film-raw.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 --concurrency 6 && npm run master
scripts.master: ffmpeg -y -v error -i out/ishara-film-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/ishara-film.mp4
